title: xicplan/1: what `mzlab-cli trace xic --dry-run` would extract
description: The extraction a run would do, written without reading the data of the file (a missing file is still exit 4). With --sweep: the sweep and its matrix. Code: crates/mzlab-cli/src/trace_xic.rs.

polarity.description: null: every scan of the level.

smooth.description: The smoothing filter, null for none.

format.description: The format the run would write.

output.description: The --out path, null for the standard output.

id.description: xic:<mz>, the id of the trace the run writes.

tolerance_da.description: Half-window in Da (for ppm, of this m/z).

sweep.description: Only with --sweep LO:HI:STEP: the sweep as given, the number of centres, and whether the half-window is the default STEP/2 in Da.

matrix_bytes_per_scan.description: Only with --sweep: n x 8 bytes; times the scans of the section is the matrix the run holds (the scans are not read in a dry run). The run is refused (error.memoryBudget, exit 1) when the matrix is over half the memory budget.
